help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Questions & Answers
help.contactDesc: A question not covered here? Write to us — we reply within 24h.

faq.a1: The scanner captures your VTC app's screen via the accessibility service, extracts trip details (fare, distance, duration) using OCR, and shows you a verdict based on your minimum rates.
faq.a2: Uber, Bolt and Heetch are currently supported. More platforms are coming soon.
faq.a3: Make sure both permissions are granted in the scanner setup screen: "Display over other apps" and "Accessibility service" must both be enabled.
faq.q4: How do I change my minimum rates?
faq.a4: Go to Profile → Trip Preferences. Adjust the sliders for hourly rate and per-km rate. Changes apply immediately.
faq.q5: How do I cancel my Plus subscription?
faq.a5: On Android: Google Play → Subscriptions. On iOS: Settings → Your name → Subscriptions. Find Strive and tap Cancel.
faq.a6: Yes. Scanning happens on your device and no screenshots are stored. Your trips are stored securely, never sold or shared, and Strive has no connection with the VTC platforms. You can wipe everything anytime from Profile → Account.
faq.q7: How is my hourly rate (€/h) calculated?
faq.a7: Strive starts from the ride fare, adds the pickup time to reach the rider, and computes the real drive time using live traffic. You get your true €/h, not a straight-line guess.
faq.q8: How do fuel cost and net profit work?
faq.a8: From your vehicle's consumption (L/100km, or kWh/100km for electric) and the fuel price, Strive deducts each ride's cost to show your net profit. For electric, you can set your own €/kWh price in Profile → Vehicle.
faq.q9: What is the ride quality score?
faq.a9: A score out of 100 given to each ride by comparing its €/h and €/km to your thresholds: green above, orange close, red below. In Stats you also see the average quality of your accepted rides.
faq.a10: 3 scans per day on the free plan, 15 per day with Strive Plus.
faq.a11: From Profile → My tickets: open a ticket and we reply right inside the app (you get a notification for every reply).

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.q1: How does the 7-day free trial work?
faq.a1: The first 7 days are 100% free. Cancel anytime from iOS Settings before the trial ends and you won't be charged. Otherwise, the subscription auto-renews at the regular price.
faq.a2: Yes. 1 tap from iOS Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. No questions, no friction, no commitment.
faq.q3: What ride apps does Strive support?
faq.a3: Uber, Bolt, Heetch and any rideshare app that shows the ride offer on screen. Strive scans any screenshot to extract the price, distance and time.
faq.a4: Everything is encrypted and stored securely. No data sold, no ads, no third-party tracking. You can delete your account anytime from the app.
